The '''Vulpter Orbital''' was an annual race held by the [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereen]] population of the planet [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]] to provide some diversion from their otherwise rough lives. Each year, contestants raced through the [[Orbital Advertisement Ring|orbital advertisement field]] until one racer crossed the finish line or all the other racers were eliminated. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], one of the contestants in the race was a talented [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] contact named [[Lon Wert]].
